title: Loeb Fellowship 2027-2028
about: The Loeb Fellowship at the Harvard Graduate School of Design, United States, is open to mid-career practitioners with at least eight years of experience. Applications for the 2027-2028 class are submitted through SlideRoom and are due 5 January 2027.
requirements: Mid-career, with a minimum of 8 years of experience in the field
card_alt: Card for the Loeb Fellowship 2027-2028 at the Harvard Graduate School of Design in Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States, deadline 5 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Statue of Liberty and the Manhattan skyline in New York, not Cambridge.
